name: Elias Whitmore
title: Fourth-Generation Captain
bio: Elias learned the trade from his grandfather on these same waters. He hand-grades every lobster that bears the Winter Harbor Blue seal.
quote: The cold water does the work. We just know when they're ready.

name: Sarah Mitchell
title: Master Lobsterman
bio: One of the first women to captain a commercial fleet in Downeast Maine. Sarah's select-grade lobsters supply Michelin-starred kitchens from Boston to Montréal.
quote: Every lobster has a story. We make sure it gets told.

name: James O'Brien
title: Dock Master & Captain
bio: James oversees pier operations and sets the grading standards that define our Chef's Reserve tier.
quote: If I wouldn't serve it at my own table, it doesn't leave the dock.

name: Maria Chen
title: Sustainability Lead
bio: Maria bridges traditional harvesting with modern traceability—every batch she handles is QR-coded before it reaches the holding tank.
quote: Luxury and stewardship aren't opposites. They're the same commitment.
